meta.title: Re-open closed line items with a new duration
gaps: Assert that the selected line items become active for bidding again with the newly entered duration.
Verify the backend-applied duration for each reopened line item.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that the selected line items become active for bidding again with the newly entered duration.; Verify the backend-applied duration for each reopened line item.

steps.note: Open the prepared buyer view for the serial bidding auction with an ended line item.
Verify that reopening ended line items is offered.
Open the reopen line items drawer.
Verify that the reopen drawer is displayed.

args.goal: In the Re-Open Line Items drawer, enter a new duration for each eligible ended line item, select at least one ended line item, click Re-Open, and stop when the drawer shows the successful reopen result.

steps.note: Perform the duration entry, line selection, and reopen action that no catalog domain step can express precisely.
Confirm the reopen operation did not produce an application error.
